feature: Finite Japanese iron-sand production and pre-Edo medieval furnaces
scope: RimWorld 1.6 independent iron-sand deposit, charcoal, three smelting scales and Vanilla/MO output integration

queries: RimWorld 1.6 iron sand tatara 砂鉄 製鉄
RimWorld bloomery smelting ore to Steel 1.6
Vanilla Factions Expanded Medieval 2 forge bellows iron
Japanese tatara RimWorld Workshop old 1.0 newer 1.6 rice integrated
search.limitations: 1.6 installed Vanilla Core/trader values and current Expanded Materials Metals and Rice/tatara executable Defs were not supplied; broad-scope mandatory alternatives are nevertheless ruled out on publicly documented dependency and ownership conflicts. 1.6 runtime outcome and interoperability not tested; later source changes require refresh.

comparison.function: Vanilla supplies smithing/final Steel; MO supplies IronOre, IronIngot, coal, smelter and Mine Shaft; neither reviewed chain is the requested finite sand path.
comparison.historical_fit: Generic iron and ore not regionally Japanese; MO fantasy/high-yield routes require separate Japanization.
comparison.dependencies: Vanilla mandatory; MO optional. MO mandatory conflicts with standalone.
comparison.retention: Reuse Vanilla Bills/Steel and integrate MO resources when present; do not remove MO.
comparison.progression_balance: Keep generic smithing and research distinct; Japanization handles MO-specific supply rebalancing.
comparison.reuse: Vanilla worktable/Recipe patterns; MO-compatible final IronIngot.
comparison.maintenance_license: No MO XML/assets copied; only observations and names referenced.

comparison.function: Environment owns terrain, Japanization owns conditional MO changes; no other AMJ owner implements standalone Japanese iron sand.
comparison.historical_fit: A finite regional Japanese ore-and-smelting loop is Ironmaking's authored scope.
comparison.retention: Preserve Environment/Grains/Waterworks ownership instead of absorbing features.
comparison.progression_balance: Sand source to bloom to final general metal adds a distinct early domestic production path.
comparison.reuse: Optional terrain and MO data integration only.
comparison.maintenance_license: All new AMJ Defs are independently authored; no foreign art/code reuse.

comparison.function: Adds smithing anvil/forge bellows production Linkables and broad medieval faction systems.
comparison.historical_fit: Medieval forge support applies, but finite Japanese iron-sand production stages are not established in inspected source.
comparison.dependencies: Requires VEF and much larger faction/technology content.
comparison.retention: Retain it as optional equipment support; requiring entire feature package is disproportionate.
comparison.progression_balance: Bellows discount could affect future furnace balance, so check fuel once.
comparison.reuse: Optional efficiency/linkable compatibility; no shared required framework.
comparison.maintenance_license: Official public XML inspected, no code or art imported.

comparison.function: NECIron, bloomery and coal-to-Steel; patches MineableSteel to ore globally.
comparison.historical_fit: Generic smelting overlaps early iron, not the approved additive regional sand deposit plus medieval-specific progression.
comparison.dependencies: Would require keeping the mod and patching global mineable changes back.
comparison.retention: Large interference to suppress basic ore replacement while retaining bloomery.
comparison.progression_balance: Generic ore chain does not give local sand-iron geography and selectable Japanese tier size.
comparison.reuse: Use Vanilla production patterns, not this Mod's content as a dependency.

comparison.function: Ore + coal to Steel in Owl_Bloomery, edits Vanilla MineableSteel.
comparison.historical_fit: Generic bloomery is prior art, not a Japanese finite sand terrain resource.
comparison.dependencies: Old upstream not verified for 1.6; would globally replace mining.
comparison.retention: Keeping generic system would not meet local sand source without invasive patches.
comparison.progression_balance: Single ore-to-Steel chain not the three historical production scales.
comparison.reuse: Reference Bill/smelter pattern only, independently implement.
comparison.maintenance_license: Old GitHub public XML inspected; no copying.

comparison.function: Multiple metallic ores, charcoal, refining and alloys; generic broad metals economy.
comparison.historical_fit: General smelting overlap, not evidence of a narrow Japanese sand-to-medieval line.
comparison.dependencies: Workshop requires Argonic Core + VEF; violates minimal standalone requirement.
comparison.retention: Much unrelated content would need retention or hiding.
comparison.progression_balance: Broad metal tiers and economy differ from small/improved/medieval scale alternatives.
comparison.reuse: Only optional compatibility/prior art if final source and licensing permit.
comparison.maintenance_license: Current 1.6 XML not reviewed; no negative assertions about hidden Recipes; no reuse.

candidates.name: Original Tatara and Rice Cultivating Civilization

comparison.function: Original Japanese smelting thematically overlaps; rice integrated successor includes tatara-related content.
comparison.historical_fit: Historical motif fits, but rice/food/brewing package is not a standalone finite Japanese ore-chain implementation.
comparison.dependencies: Modern pack requires Harmony plus broader crop/food systems; original 1.0 is not a verified 1.6 replacement.
comparison.retention: Making broad rice pack required retains unrelated large agriculture chain.
comparison.progression_balance: Unknown exact 1.6 recipes, no evidence of the desired scale choices and optional MO exit.
comparison.reuse: No assets or XML imported; potential existing standalone usage is not established.
comparison.maintenance_license: Original old, successor 1.6 Def uninspected and redistribution not permitted.

comparison.function: Reorders MO/VE research and introduces production tier requirements.
comparison.historical_fit: Research progression prior art, not new finite sand deposit and bloom smelting production.
comparison.dependencies: Requires ReplaceLib and target MO/VE Mods; not Vanilla-only.
comparison.retention: Retains foreign research tree changes unrelated to AMJ.
comparison.progression_balance: Progression patch cannot supply finite resources or working furnaces by itself.
comparison.reuse: No dependency; research compatibility concept only.
comparison.maintenance_license: Description inspected, no Mod code/art reused.

decision.rationale: Preserve base Vanilla steel/smithing and other Mods while adding a finite Japanese iron-sand extraction path and historically differentiated smelting capacities without forcing MO, VEF or rice/metal economy packs. Each candidate's required scope/dependency or global ore change contradicts the accepted standalone owner contract.
decision.independent_gap: Local finite sand-iron deposits with terrain variation, early/improved/medieval Japanese furnace choices, independent Vanilla support and optional MO IronIngot output without global Vanilla/MO mineable/trader rewrites.
